newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Kredietbank opens branch office in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Kredietbank opens branch office in Shanghai.

text.p: Belgian Kredietbank has opened a branch office in Shanghai, making it the first Belgian bank branch in China, Kredietbank said in a statement on Monday.
The office is in Pudong, the financial area of Shanghai, and employs 30 Chinese, one Hong Kong Chinese and one European.

Kredietbank chairman Marcel Cockaerts said the office was part of Kredietbank's network in South-East Asia, which includes branches in Hong Kong, Singapore, Taipei and Manilla, and representative offices in Bangkok, Jakarta and Bombay.

The Shanghai office would focus on short-term financing of large local firms and foreign investors, trade with China,and project financing. It would be one of the few foreign bank branches with a complete dealing room for foreign currency and money market activities.
